Featured project

Dubai Property Market 2026

Every property sale registered with the Dubai Land Department from January to September 2026, plus 25,988 new leases and 2026 service charges. Cleaned, modelled, analysed and delivered as an interactive dashboard and a Power BI report.

PythonSQL (DuckDB)Power BIDAXChart.jsJupyter

A finding the average hides

The simple average price per sq ft fell about 12% between January and September. My like-for-like index of 47 apartment areas shows the real change is far smaller, because the average dropped mostly when more sales happened in cheaper areas.

Price per sq ft change, January to September

75%of home sales were off-plan. Off-plan apartments cost 26% more per sq ft than ready ones
8.2% vs 5.4%gross rental yield, cheapest third of areas vs priciest third

How I work

From messy sheet to clear answer

01

Understand

What decision do you need to make? Where does the data live, and who will use the result?

02

Clean

Duplicates, wrong formats and impossible values are found, counted and fixed. Every removed row is logged.

03

Model

A tidy star schema in SQL or Power BI, with each measure written once and reused.

04

Design

KPI cards, charts and filters that answer your questions instead of filling the page.

05

Deliver

The finished file, a short guide to refresh it, and the numbers behind every chart.

Automation and AI

Workflows that run while you work

I build n8n workflows that collect data, clean it, check it and hand it over ready to use. Here is the layout of one I run daily for a Dubai recruitment firm, simplified.

TriggerRuns on a schedule
CollectPulls new job listings through APIs
CleanRemoves jobs already seen
VerifyFinds and checks contacts with REST APIs
AI stepAn LLM drafts an opening, then checks run
SaveClean rows in Google Sheets
